provenance.source: FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis)

assumptions: Series are used as published, with no seasonal or inflation adjustment applied by us beyond whatever the series itself already carries.
Some series lag: GDP is quarterly, CPI monthly, Treasury yields daily. The 'latest' value is the latest PUBLISHED value, not today's reality.
Revisions happen. A figure pulled today may differ from the same figure pulled next month.
_meta.disclaimer: Research output, not financial advice. Figures marked basis=vendor_estimate or basis=projected are forecasts, not reported facts.

data.note: Macro context only. These figures describe the economy, not any single company. They are used to sanity-check the discount rate and to notice when a thesis depends on a macro assumption (rates falling, consumer holding up) that the data does not support.
